fusions.name: Strung With Tresses
fusions.desc: Shoots an arrow from a string plaited of your own hair at a target up to 10 tiles away, dealing 8 piercing damage that rises to 1.8 times that at full reach. Holds 5 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Loosed Sheaf
fusions.desc: Draws every strand back to full tension and looses 4 hair-thin shafts at once, spread apart, each dealing 13 piercing damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Longer Draw
fusions.desc: Lengthens the string with more of your hair: for 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far.

fusions.name: Filament Points
fusions.desc: Your arrowheads are drawn out to the width of one strand: your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
